receipt_type: N4 unit-gate helper setup and list-only selection evidence
time_note: The task requested a 45-minute maximum, but its start timestamp was not captured; no inferred deadline is recorded.

setup_causes_and_corrections.cause: The N4 retargeted F3b helper initially expected build status and source pins under N4 itself, although the authoritative build509 receipts live under N4/reference_build.
setup_causes_and_corrections.correction: Retargeted the helper to read the status and pins from N4/reference_build. The staged run_cases-compatible build509 alias remains generated from those verified receipts; no separate N4-local source/status copy is used.

setup_causes_and_corrections.cause: run_cases.main raises SystemExit(0) on a successful cohort, which would have stopped G1 after the first serial cohort.
setup_causes_and_corrections.correction: The wrapper catches successful SystemExit and rethrows nonzero exits so later cohorts can continue.

setup_causes_and_corrections.cause: A standalone Catch2 `~[.]` comma term is ORed with the inclusion terms and can select every nonhidden test, rather than excluding hidden tests from each inclusion.
setup_causes_and_corrections.correction: The helper appends `~[.]` to each comma-separated inclusion term, making the exclusion conjunctive for every OR branch. Actual driver list-only checks verified exact source-derived selections.

setup_causes_and_corrections.cause: An inline integer-row parser was initially drafted and did not preserve the comparator's canonical marker parsing and measurement exclusions, including TIMER call counters.
setup_causes_and_corrections.correction: The wrapper imports the existing sibling compare_integer_rows.py and uses marker_rows and integer_values. TIMER `calls` remain canonical integer values. The comparator file was not edited; its path is included in the G3 extra source pins.

setup_causes_and_corrections.cause: The first list-only attempt in the default sandbox could not initialize OpenMPI because local socket creation was denied. A first unsandboxed attempt then failed MPI_Win_create because it lacked the existing runner's OSC setting.
setup_causes_and_corrections.correction: List-only enumeration used the runner's OMPI_MCA_osc=pt2pt setting. No tests were executed. The initial sandbox socket failure and the intermediate MPI_Win_create failure were not treated as test results.

g1_source_catalog.guard_rule: A tag is classified rank-guarded only when every case carrying that tag has a lexical if(world.size|world.rank) in the test body.
g1_source_catalog.selection_scope: Serial filter supplements run_cases.CASES['serial_full'] with all cataloged Native*3D tags plus NativeGeometryBackend3D, NativeTimerTree3D, NativeBoundedGuidance3D, and NativeBoundaryGuidanceMemo3D. MPI2 and MPI4 filters supplement the existing mpi2 cohort with the 32 rank-guarded tags. Each OR term excludes hidden tests with ~[.].
limits: The catalog parser inventories CNativeDistributed3D_tests.cpp; the four named supplementary tags cover selected additional backend/timer/guidance tests outside that catalog.
Rank-guard classification is lexical and is not runtime proof that all branches are safe at both two and four ranks.
Actual list-only enumeration validates selected names against source-derived test declarations; it does not execute tests or establish gate behavior.

list_only_selections.exit_code_explanation: Catch's list operation returns the number of listed names; 375 modulo the shell's 8-bit process status is 119.

list_only_selections.cohort: G1 MPI guarded selection, used at 2 and 4 ranks

helper_checks.read_only_self_check: pass: syntax, BL reference, build509 terminal and pins, row comparator TIMER calls handling
